triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_order_status_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' or new.status is distinct from old.status then
    insert into public.order_status_history(order_id, status)
    values (new.id, coalesce(nullif(trim(new.status::text), ''), 'pending'));
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

triggers.name: trg_restore_order_stock_on_cancel
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_restore_order_stock_on_cancel AFTER UPDATE ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION restore_order_stock_on_cancel()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restore_order_stock_on_cancel()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  item_row record;
  v_previous_stock integer;
begin
  if new.fulfillment_mode = 'made_to_order' then
    return new;
  end if;

  if old.status = 'cancelled' or new.status <> 'cancelled' then
    return new;
  end if;

  for item_row in
    select oi.product_id, oi.quantity
    from public.order_items oi
    where oi.order_id = new.id
      and oi.product_id is not null
  loop
    select stock_quantity
    into v_previous_stock
    from public.products
    where id = item_row.product_id
    for update;

    update public.products
    set stock_quantity = stock_quantity + item_row.quantity
    where id = item_row.product_id;

    insert into public.inventory_adjustments (
      product_id,
      order_id,
      adjustment_type,
      quantity_change,
      previous_stock,
      new_stock,
      notes
    )
    values (
      item_row.product_id,
      new.id,
      'order_cancelled',
      item_row.quantity,
      v_previous_stock,
      v_previous_stock + item_row.quantity,
      'Stock restored from order cancellation'
    );
  end loop;

  return new;
end;
$function$
